name: Curves
description: Tone curves: FFmpeg's presets, or a custom curve through one middle point per channel.

params.name: preset
params.description: Preset: 0 = none, 1 = color_negative, 2 = cross_process, 3 = darker, 4 = increase_contrast, 5 = lighter, 6 = linear_contrast, 7 = medium_contrast, 8 = negative, 9 = strong_contrast, 10 = vintage

params.name: master
params.description: Middle point (x, y) of the master curve through (0, 0) and (1, 1); (0.5, 0.5) leaves the preset in place

params.name: red
params.description: Middle point (x, y) of the red curve; (0.5, 0.5) leaves the preset in place

params.name: green
params.description: Middle point (x, y) of the green curve; (0.5, 0.5) leaves the preset in place

params.name: blue
params.description: Middle point (x, y) of the blue curve; (0.5, 0.5) leaves the preset in place
